newsitem.title: MOROCCO: SOCCER-CROATIA BEAT CZECH REPUBLIC TO WIN HASSAN TROPHY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROATIA BEAT CZECH REPUBLIC TO WIN HASSAN TROPHY.

text.p: Croatia won the four-nation Hassan Trophy soccer tournament on Thursday by beating the Czech Republic 4-1 in a penalty shootout.
Czech goalkeeper Petr Kouba was unable to stop the Croatians sweeping to victory in the shootout after the teams drew 1-1 after 90 minutes.
Croatia's Radek Drulak scored in the fourth minute of the final and Morocco drew level in the 29th when Pralja Nenad hammered the ball into the net after a cross from Igore Svimalojic.
"From the beginning we knew that we would win this tournament if we beat the Moroccan team in the semifinal," Croatian coach Mirslav Blazevic told reporters.
Earlier, Morocco beat Nigeria 2-0 (halftime 0-0) with Salaheddine Bassir (49th minute) and Abdellatif Jrindo (90th) scoring for the home side.
